name: Kashagan MPFM deployment (NCOC/Schlumberger), Kashagan field, Kazakhstan
description: multiphase flow meters on unmanned production islands: one MPFM per group of wells on some islands, one per well on others; used for allocation, well testing and virtual-meter calibration

sources.note: SPE-191644 abstract (Mursaliyev et al., 2018, Multiphase Flow Meter Implementation, Verification and Use for Calibration of Virtual Metering in Kashagan Project) as mirrored on the academia.edu page read 2026-10-28
